data.gender_notes: Manuan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Menachem' meaning 'consolation', 'Manuan' can be interpreted as 'God is man'. In the Old Testament, Menachem was a king of Israel who brought comfort to his people. In the New Testament, the name can be seen as a reminder of God's presence among us as human beings. The name Manuan carries the meaning “God is man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Manuan usually hope their child will grow to embody god is man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: מנואן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם מנואן נגזר מהשורשים העבריים 'מנה' ו'אל', ומשמעותו 'מתנת אלוהים' או 'משיחו של האל'. השם מופיע בשורשים עבריים ומעיד על קשר ישיר לאלוהים, כמתנה או כמשיח.

in_greek.name: Μανουάν
in_greek.meaning: Δωρεὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ, Χριστός τοῦ Θεοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Μανουάν ἐκ τῶν Ἑβραϊκῶν ῥιζῶν 'Μαν' καὶ 'Αλ', καὶ σημαίνει 'Δωρεὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ' ἤ 'Χριστός τοῦ Θεοῦ'. Ἐμφανίζεται εἰς τὰ Ἑβραϊκά ῥίζα καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ σχέσεως πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν, ὡς δωρεὰ ἤ Χριστός.

in_latin.name: Manuan
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Manuan ex radicibus Hebraicis 'Man' et 'Al' derivatur, et significat 'Donum Dei' vel 'Christus Domini'. Apparetur in radicibus Hebraicis et testificatur de connexione directa ad Deum, ut donum vel Christus.

Historically, names with similar roots have been used in biblical contexts to denote special favor or designation by God. The spiritual significance of Manuan encompasses themes of divine favor, blessing, and anointment for a purpose. In Christian tradition, such names are often chosen for their profound meanings and the virtues they represent.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Manuan' reflects the belief in the interconnectedness of God and humanity. It highlights the idea that we are not separate from the divine but an integral part of it. data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Manuan' serves as a powerful reminder of the divine presence within each of us as human beings. data.spiritual_symbolism: Manuan may be derived from the Tagalog word "manunangging," meaning "light-bearer" or "enlightener." historical_references.reference: Manuan, a native chief of Luzon, who submitted to Spanish rule in 1574, became a Christian and was named 'Don Alonso Manuan'. He was later appointed as the 'gobernador' of the town of Tanza in Cavite province.

Manuan, a Tagalog prince of Bukidnon, southern Philippines, who embraced Christianity in the late 17th century. He is best known for his role in the spread of Christianity in the region and was a significant ally for the Spanish missionaries.
